culprit_citations.quoted_text: Truck-Lite Co., LLC: amortized cost 300,603; fair value 300,658
Total Investments: amortized cost 8,595,040; fair value 8,632,315

findings.detail: B01 divides 241 fair-value leaves by 482 combined amortized-cost and fair-value leaves, producing an artificial 50 percent coverage rate.

rationale: Raw source shows investment rows contain paired amortized-cost and fair-value cells, while the schedule total fair value of 8,632.315 million exactly matches the extracted fund-quarter fair value. The 241/482 metric therefore counts both value columns in its denominator; it does not demonstrate 241 holdings with missing fair value. The data are correct and the B01 check scope is wrong.
